title: Klyro DNS Server Configuration
description: Configuration file for the Klyro DNS server.

$schema.description: Path to this JSON Schema file.

listen_addr.description: Address and port for the DNS server to listen on.

http_addr.description: Address and port for the HTTP API and dashboard.

upstreams.description: List of upstream DNS servers to forward queries to.

config_dir.description: Path to the directory containing zone YAML files.

username.description: Username for dashboard login. Overridden by KLYRO_USER env var.

password.description: Password for dashboard login. Overridden by KLYRO_PASS env var.
